Degrees of freedom = number of parameters that are free to vary. *p* + *q* = 1, so *df*=1. 


## Chi-Squared Distribution  

Probability Density Function:

$$
f(k) = \frac{1}{2^{k/2} \Gamma (k/2)} x^{k/2-1} e^{-x/2}
$$
  
where *k* = degrees of freedom and *x* is the test statistic (i.e., what you use to determine the p-value)
